digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing (canary-bridge filers and reconciler conflict filer)
propositions: Automated bug filers (heartbeat, binding-drift, conflict-filer) lack dedup mechanisms and file tickets on single flakes or transient failures, causing duplicate spam.
No unified contract exists for auto-bug-creation; filers have inconsistent argument passing, dedup search strategies, and abort conditions.
Heartbeat filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history (previous run conclusion) to avoid filing on single flakes.
Binding-drift and conflict filers must implement stable per-check dedup tags, templated bodies with required fields, and abort-if-empty checks.
Accumulation-comment dedup (max one per 24h, marked by stable identifier in comment history) must be implemented across all filers to prevent spam despite threshold passes.
A machine-readable bug-creation contract must document rebar create arguments, dedup search commands, detected_by env var, exit codes, and recovery behavior for future filers.
